title: MHADA Pune lottery 2026: homes in Lohegaon, Kharadi, Keshav Nagar-Mundhwa and Dhanori (20% scheme), apply by 22 October
audience: Marathi families in east Pune (Lohegaon, Kharadi, Keshav Nagar, Mundhwa, Dhanori, Viman Nagar) with family income up to 9 lakh, first home, 22-45
message: This MHADA Pune lottery has homes in our own areas: Lohegaon from 21.70 lakh, Kharadi 13.89 lakh, Keshav Nagar-Mundhwa from 16.79 lakh, Dhanori from 13.91 lakh; apply only on MHADA's site by 22 October and check the price there.
facts: The MHADA Pune board lottery 2026 has 4,462 homes; the 20% inclusive housing scheme part has homes inside private projects. Source: Lokmat Times, Free Press Journal.

Lohegaon, as listed: Mindspace Residency Phase 1, 1 BHK 21.70 lakh and 2 BHK 25.46 lakh; Prasun Elara, 2 BHK 28.46 lakh; Maitri Meadows, 2 BHK 28.88 lakh. Source: the 20% scheme list published on sarkariproperty.com, read 18 October 2026.
Kharadi, as listed: Zen Elite, 1 BHK 13.89 lakh. Same source.

Keshav Nagar and Mundhwa, as listed: Amara Keshavnagar, 2 BHK 26.92 lakh; Atulyam Inclusive Housing, 1 BHK from 16.79 lakh and 1.5 BHK 23.62 lakh; Uni 89 Wing C, 1 BHK 17.81 lakh and 2 BHK 21.63 lakh. Same source.
Dhanori, as listed: Kohinoor Viva Pixel Phase II, 1 RK 13.91 lakh and 1 BHK 20.29 lakh; Nyati Era II, 1 BHK 18.06 lakh; Aaiji Crystal Phase 1, 2 BHK 20.84 lakh. Same source.
No home in Wagholi was found in this list.
These are the listed prices; the exact price, size and conditions are on MHADA's official site, scheme by scheme.
The last date to apply and pay the deposit online is 22 October 2026, 11:59 pm. Source: MHADA Pune board, extension of 14 October 2026.
Applications are made only on MHADA's official site.

reply_facts: This MHADA Pune lottery's 20% inclusive housing scheme has homes in our areas. As listed in the published scheme list (read 18 October 2026; check the exact price on MHADA's official site): Lohegaon - Mindspace Residency Phase 1 (1 BHK 21.70 lakh, 2 BHK 25.46 lakh), Prasun Elara (2 BHK 28.46 lakh), Maitri Meadows (2 BHK 28.88 lakh).

Kharadi - Zen Elite (1 BHK 13.89 lakh). Keshav Nagar / Mundhwa - Amara Keshavnagar (2 BHK 26.92 lakh), Atulyam Inclusive Housing (1 BHK from 16.79 lakh, 1.5 BHK 23.62 lakh), Uni 89 Wing C (1 BHK 17.81 lakh, 2 BHK 21.63 lakh).
Dhanori - Kohinoor Viva Pixel Phase II (1 RK 13.91 lakh, 1 BHK 20.29 lakh), Nyati Era II (1 BHK 18.06 lakh), Aaiji Crystal Phase 1 (2 BHK 20.84 lakh). No home in Wagholi was found in this list.
Other parts of Pune and PCMC also have homes in this lottery (for example Hadapsar, Charholi, Undri, Kondhwa); MHADA's official site lists every scheme with its price and size.
The last date to apply and pay the deposit online is 22 October 2026, 11:59 pm; RTGS/NEFT payment by 23 October 2026, 3:59 pm. The draw is planned for 4 December 2026.
Family income limits: EWS up to 6 lakh a year, LIG 6 to 9 lakh (applicant plus spouse). Deposit (EMD): 15,000 for EWS, 20,000 for LIG, plus the 708 application fee.
Applications are made only on MHADA's official site; Avasetu does not take applications or money and cannot improve anyone's chances in the draw.
The pictures in the reel are illustrations, not the actual buildings.
